Mapping/labels: https://www.inegi.org.mx/contenidos/programas/ensu/datosabiertos/conjunto_de_datos_ensu_2025_3t_csv.zip (sha256 a9f5b5411a2d6b099e529e8a6d945498b13638e8e32e79ced1072d27df2ba836, fetched 2026-09-28), conjunto_de_datos_ensu_cb_0925/diccionario_de_datos/diccionario_de_datos_ensu_cb_0925.csv (variable labels), catalogos/bp2_*.csv (value labels) and conjunto_de_datos/conjunto_de_datos_ensu_cb_0925.csv (raw data, sha256 468e812b57cc1a6e39a74ff8e97d319616d2be7c05a683493cfb8890806ace4a).
note: Codes: data/mexico_2025_safety.do (Bookmark #10, Q3 2025 Conflicts; exports mexico_2025_q3safety_conflicts.csv) keeps INEGI columns bp2_1..bp2_4_11 from conjunto_de_datos_ensu_cb_0925.csv (imported lowercased) and reshapes long with item = column name (core model s3 pattern 1, no positional step); recodes (Section II, all quarters): bp2_1 9 -> missing, bp2_3_* 9 -> missing. mapping_basis=data_labels: INEGI's own 2025 Q3 data dictionary labels each BP2_* column (e.g. BP2_2_16 'Conflictos o enfrentamientos: Grafiti o pintas a su casa por alguien que usted identifique'; BP2_3_4 'Incidentes o problemas con desconocidos(as) en la calle'; BP2_4_09 'Tipo de consecuencias derivadas de conflictos: Dialogo/platica'); 37/37 agree in content with the Q3 questionnaire option carrying the same code number. 2025 Q3 vs 2025 Q2 source check (done, not assumed): same 37 BP2_* variables; all 82 BP2_* diccionario rows identical to Q2 2025's (dictionary changes between the quarters are all outside Section II: PER range, BP1_2_03/BP1_2_12 labels, BP1_6_* re-coded, BP3_3..BP3_6 and BP4_1_* dropped, BP4_*/BP5_* family-violence and trust blocks added, ID_PERT/ID_VIVT/LOC replaced by CVEGEO/CVE_LOC); all 37 catalogos/bp2_*.csv byte-identical to Q2 2025's. Questionnaire Section II: CP2 introduction, 2.1-2.4 stems and 34 of 36 option texts identical to the Q2 print; three print changes, all confirmed on a 150-dpi render of pp.3-4 and shipped as printed: (a) option 2.2-12 now reads 'conflicto en la compra / consumo de producto / servicio en un establecimiento comercial?' (Q2 'compra/consumo de producto/servicio'); (b) 2.3 option 3 now 'Companeros(as) de trabajo / escuela' (Q2 'trabajo/escuela'); (c) 2.4 option 9 now 'Dialogo/platica' (Q2 'Dialogo / platica'). All three are slash-spacing only. Also the 2.4 option 5 line now shows a leading ellipsis glyph before the dot leader ('etcetera)...05'); treated as part of the leader and stripped, same text as Q2. Option 15 'un (una) servidor(a) publico(a)' unchanged from Q2 (text layer). All 38 distinct Spanish strings shipped are found in the Q3 text layer after whitespace/dot-leader normalisation. Cross-check (route 9 style): all 74 live item x level counts (server-side GROUP BY item,resp, no export) equal the raw INEGI 2025 Q3 CSV after the .do's recodes, 74/74 (e.g. bp2_1 1/2 = 9102/14532, bp2_2_01 0/1 = 6410/2692, bp2_2_18 0/1 = 7588/1514, bp2_2_16 0/1 = 8614/488, bp2_3_2 0/1 = 2103/5466, bp2_4_09 0/1 = 3368/4220). Raw 23642 rows (PER=0325 on every row), 8 bp2_1=9 set missing -> 23634 live distinct ids = live bp2_1 n; live COUNT(*) 323921 = 23634 + 18x9102 + 7x7569 + 11x7588, no missing resp, no duplicate id x item; 19 respondents coded 9 on all seven bp2_3_* set missing (bp2_3 n = 7569 vs bp2_4 n = 7588). NOT truncated (cf. batch_692). Words: item_text / section_prompt / instructions are the administered questionnaire wording (text_source=study_materials), not the terser dictionary labels. Kept as printed: '(as)' gender fills, 'un (una)', trailing '?' on 2.2 options, the stem's trailing ellipsis, slash spacing. Normalised: line wraps joined. Stripped: question numbers, option codes, dot leaders, 'ESPECIFIQUE' blanks after Otro, interviewer directions (MUESTRE LA TARJETA 'B' Y CIRCULE UN SOLO CODIGO / LOS CODIGOS CORRESPONDIENTES; CIRCULE LOS CODIGOS CORRESPONDIENTES; PASE A LA SECCION III; SI SE REGISTRO CODIGO 18 'NINGUNO', PASE A LA SECCION III). Structure (same as batch_680/685/689/693): section _1 = 2.1 screener (stem in item_text), _2 = 2.2 (stem in section_prompt, option wording in item_text), _3 = 2.3, _4 = 2.4; instructions = CP2 read-aloud introduction. Options: bp2_1 1=Si, 2=No (questionnaire and catalogo; 9 set missing by the .do, no row). The 36 checklist items are 0/1 flags; option_text is INEGI's catalogo value label ('0' = 'No se declaro como opcion afirmativa', '1' = 'Si'), not questionnaire print. Every level each item's respondents used has an option row. Routing (not a defect): 2.2 asked only if 2.1=Si (n=9102 = bp2_1 Si count); 2.3/2.4 skipped when 2.2 code 18 'Ninguno' was circled (7588 = 9102 - 1514). Step 3b: live items match this question block exactly (37 = 1 + 18 + 7 + 11); dictionary Description ('Q3 2025') accurate, but the dictionary Reference names 'ENSU 2023' while data and wording are the 2025 Q3 (septiembre 2025, file suffix 0925) wave -- same defect as the siblings. English in _translated is this project's own translation (machine_translation), reused verbatim from batch_693 for 68/74 rows; the 3 items whose Spanish print changed (bp2_2_12, bp2_3_3, bp2_4_09; 6 rows) got fresh English mirroring the new slash spacing ('purchase / consumption of a product / service'; 'Co-workers / schoolmates'; 'Dialogue/conversation'). INEGI publishes no English questionnaire. Rights: instrument_rights_register.csv INEGI row verdict=ship (Ben 2026-09-23, irw#2381 R01; INEGI Terminos de libre uso, attribution only), applied not re-derived; credit condition applied in public_note.
public_note: Fuente: INEGI, Encuesta Nacional de Seguridad Pública Urbana (ENSU) 2025, tercer trimestre -- IRW transcribed Section II (questions 2.1-2.4) from INEGI's questionnaire, stripped interviewer directions, used INEGI's data-catalogue labels for the 0/1 checklist codes, and added an English translation of its own; INEGI does not endorse this item text.
